eyebrow: SQL Dialects: T-SQL, PL/SQL, MySQL & Beyond · Chapter One
subtitle: Lesson 2 · The Landscape

code:
SQL Server   -> T-SQL
Oracle       -> PL/SQL
MySQL        -> MySQL's own dialect (MariaDB shares it)
PostgreSQL   -> PostgreSQL dialect + PL/pgSQL
caption: Four genuinely different languages for "beyond a single query."

code:
-- T-SQL:    CREATE PROCEDURE ... AS BEGIN ... END
-- PL/SQL:   CREATE PROCEDURE ... IS BEGIN ... END;
-- MySQL:    CREATE PROCEDURE ... BEGIN ... END
-- PL/pgSQL: CREATE FUNCTION ... AS $$ BEGIN ... END; $$
caption: Same idea, four distinct syntaxes -- full detail comes in Chapter 5 and 6.

eyebrow: A fifth family: cloud data warehouses
code:
Snowflake   -- own dialect, strong semi-structured (VARIANT)
Databricks  -- Spark SQL over a Spark engine
BigQuery    -- Google's warehouse, own functions
Redshift    -- forked from PostgreSQL, leans Postgres-flavored
caption: Built for analytics at scale, not transactional (OLTP) workloads.
